title: GTO: 14 Days in Shonan
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A side story to Great Teacher Onizuka: after being shot, ex-biker teacher Eikichi Onizuka slips out of hospital and lies low for two weeks in his coastal hometown of Shonan. There he gets involved with a group of foster children facing neglect and abuse and uses his unconventional, often brawling methods to help them, which explains a wanted poster that surfaces bearing his face.
life_message: Every troubled kid deserves an adult who shows up for them, no matter the cost.
